lines: The blacksmith doesn't yell as much now. He still yells. Just softer.
The broken sword? Over by the rack. I don't dare touch it, the smith would get angry.
My father was… in the order too, once. Now there's only sand.
The training yard used to be loud. Now it's only wind.
Greybeard says: while the banner still hangs, no one gets to fall first.
